name: s81hd_lane_adp_p8f-s81hd_lane_adp_p8f-COMMIT
purpose: HEAD lane (b): hardened static adapter child (FB) for s81hd_lane_p8m/p8f

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81hd_lane_adp u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay_tree3.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_util.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_lane_ha.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_adp_p8f/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_adp_p8f/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81hd_lane_adp_p8f --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81hd_lane_adp  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: s81hd_lane_adp (STW-S81c-COLLA2-VP 10-22, HEAD lane design (b), steward decision): the static core adapter of ot_s81hd_lane hardened as its OWN child with its own CTS (p3m..p7m: one parent root could not land the adapter's pin flops on the child's routed boundary at both TT and FF -- 698.4 TT 28 / FF 115, 743.4 61.5 / 85.2, p7m FF 91). Same registers and edges (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_lane_ha.sv: hierarchy only; bench PASS, OVF/RP mutants caught). The parent becomes 2 hard children (lane view + this view) with a register->register landed seam on facing W/E pins at identical y; no soft pin flops under the parent root. FB: 108-um wide adapter (lower std/pin-flop density, wider rows for the 35 slices).
